text: A turning grille: a card with 25 holes laid on a 10 x 10 grid, the message written through the holes, the card turned a quarter four times, the grid copied out row by row. Then, or first, a repeating key on the sculpture's table.

Every one of the 4^25 cards, by a search that drops a card as soon as two known letters disagree: any key of 1-6 letters, and each of 200,563 words as the key, on K4, ten scrambled copies and four planted texts.
No card fits K4 or any copy; every planted card is found. Free keys of 7-26 letters cost too much to settle (blocked); copying out by columns is 0200.
